notes.title: ⚔️ Bug Fixes & New Dialogue!
notes.content:
📜 Hello warriors! 

First of all thank you SO much to everyone who’s been playing Legacy of Sin: Ill-Boding! Your feedback has been invaluable, and today we bring you a major update with some crucial fixes and a new twist in the story:

🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements

* 🈶 Asian subtitles (Japanese, Korean, Simplified & Traditional Chinese) now display correctly!

* ♾️ Endless wave bug is gone! Those missions that never ended? They now conclude properly.

* 🛡️ Persistent attack missions fixed — certain attack missions would never end and only disappeared after ending the turn. This is now working properly.

* 🧠 Improved enemy generation logic — get ready for more varied battles!

* 🏆 All achievements are now possible to unlock — including the ones related to upgrading all units!

* 🎭 New Dialogue with Sten (SPOILER): During the showdown with Sten, a new dialogue scene has been added to better reveal his motivations and deepen the story. Prepare for an emotional turn! 

I'm always listening to your feedback — feel free to reach out through our Discord: https://discord.gg/xJHfGaSX. If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a positive review 📝 — it helps a LOT with our launch and keeps the fire burning for future updates! 🔥

Thank you for being part of this journey. More to come soon! ❤️
